hook: Lloyds' AI fraud assistant passed 90 percent accuracy.
sections: It is a team of specialist AI agents helping fraud staff.
Think of a hospital ward round. Specialist nurses gather the test results and history first, so the consultant can make the final call quickly.
First, specialist AI agents run the investigation steps on a debit-card fraud case. Second, a human fraud specialist makes the final decision.
Before, banks used rules and single models.
Now, over 10,600 live cases in 90 days, accuracy passed 90 percent, staff used about half as many systems per call, and overrides fell 30 percent.
Large banks and RegTech vendors gain. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
